canonical_title: Publisher and advertiser group seeks EU and UK intervention on Meta commercial terms
aliases: Movement for an Open Web Meta commercial terms
Meta October 30 crawler terms CMA complaint
Meta commercial terms delayed to November 20
treatment: Follow-up reported on 2026-10-23: effective date delayed to November 20; do not re-report without additional hard delta.
known_facts: Reuters 2026-10-22 14:11 UTC: Movement for an Open Web asked EU and UK regulators to suspend Meta's October 30 commercial terms.
UK CMA confirmed urgent discussions with Meta; no regulator suspension was announced.
Meta disputes that the updated terms grant new crawler rights or override robots.txt.
2026-10-23 13:37 UTC Reuters: Meta confirmed delaying updated Commercial Terms and Self-Serve Ad Terms effective date from October 30 to November 20, 2026; no regulator injunction announced.
reinclude_only_if: Interim injunction, regulator action, official revised terms, or enforceability clarification.
Material change to web-crawling clause, confirmed regulator action, or further effective-date revision.
notes: 2026-10-22 12:00–23:30 JST window; midday report not available for direct comparison. | 2026-10-23 night follow-up: date moved 30 Oct -> 20 Nov; not a substantive withdrawal of contested crawler clause.
